blurb: Guests play an 18-hole miniature golf course called Boom and Bust, located outdoors in Parklab Gardens, San Francisco. The course features artistic holes with a historical theme and is ADA compliant. Players reserve tee times online and can enjoy nearby food trucks and a beer garden.
extraNote: All sales are final; no refunds for mini golf tickets · Course usually open in all weather; may close for air quality, torrential rain, or heavy winds · Must pre-purchase tickets with reserved tee times online or via app · Stagecoach Greens kiosk in Parklab Gardens, between 3rd and 4th streets, San Francisco
